EN: Reeks of the Institute. You'll see I'm right. Oh, and there's a supply room on the way. Help yourself.
ZH: 一股学院的味道。到时候你就知道，我说得没错。哦，对了，路上有间补给室。随便拿。

EN: Things are getting worse for the Railroad. Relentless Institute attacks have cornered them in a building on the outskirts of Boston. They need help.
ZH: 铁路的日子越来越难过了。学院的穷追不舍，把他们逼到波士顿郊区一栋建筑里。他们需要帮助。

EN: Wyatt said I had a will of steel, but I'm no leader. Maybe you know one? Until then, can I hide with you?
ZH: 怀亚特说我意志如钢，但我不是当领袖的料。也许你知道谁行？在那之前，我能跟你们躲一阵吗？

EN: An Elder from the Brotherhood of Steel has proposed a meeting to discuss battle plans against the Institute. Let's see what they've got to offer.
ZH: 钢铁兄弟会的一位长老提出要会面，商讨对抗学院的作战计划。看看他们能提供什么。

EN: The Brotherhood made the mistake of becoming our enemies, so let's raid their storage and steal their Fusion Cores!
ZH: 兄弟会犯了个错误，成了我们的敌人。那我们去劫掠他们的仓库，偷走他们的聚变核心！

EN: We've found a Brotherhood of Steel prison for Synths and other “abominations”, where they do experiments on the inmates. Let's break them out!
ZH: 我们发现一座钢铁兄弟会的监狱，关押着合成人和其他“畸变体”，他们还在囚犯身上做实验。我们去把囚犯救出来！

EN: The Brotherhood did us dirty. Now it's time for some real payback. We've lured Elder Maxson and his entourage into a trap, ready for you to spring.
ZH: 兄弟会坑了我们。现在该好好回敬他们了。我们已经把麦克森长老和他的随从引入陷阱，就等你们来收网了。

EN: To test the Institute's claim of peace, we're sending a team to an abandoned lab to tap their comms network.
ZH: 为了检验学院关于和平的说法，我们派一支队伍前往一座废弃实验室，窃听他们的通讯网络。

EN: What's wrong with those tin men? Left behind to rust, like the rest of this place? Looks like they still have some fight left.
ZH: 那些铁皮人怎么了？被丢在这儿生锈，跟这地方的其他东西一样？看来它们还有几分战斗力。

EN: Our salvage team took Bigsby to the Atomatoys warehouse, but hasn't returned. Take this. You'll need it if you look for them.
ZH: 我们的救援队把比格斯比带到了原子玩具厂的仓库，但还没回来。拿上这个，找他们的时候会用到。

EN: Bigsby wasn't in Vault 199, but a member told me he may be in their sister Vault: 899. I should go check it out.
ZH: 比格斯比不在199号避难所，但一个成员告诉我它可能会在他们的姐妹避难所，899号。我应该去那儿看看。

EN: A helpful survivor who escaped from the Raiders suggested I search Vault 177 for Bottle & Cappy. If I hurry, I might be able to catch up with them.
ZH: 一位幸存者刚从掠夺者手中逃出来，他建议我们去177号避难所寻找瓶瓶和盖盖。如果抓紧时间的话，说不定能追上他们。

EN: We've almost proven the Vault's worthiness to the Brotherhood of Steel! Last task - a rescue mission at the Nuka-Cola Plant.
ZH: 已经向钢铁兄弟会证明了我们避难所的价值！最后的任务——核子可乐工厂的救援行动。

EN: A woman living by herself in an abandoned cabin is being plagued by Radroaches. We should help her with that!
ZH: 一位独居女人住在一座废弃小屋里，房间遭了虫害。我们应该帮助她！

EN: Could you kill Frank the Tank? He raids us all the time. He's in that building down the road. This might help.
ZH: 你能杀掉“坦克弗兰克”吗？他总是将我们洗劫一空。他就在这条路上的那幢建筑里。希望这些消息能帮到你。

EN: Tell you what. You kill Frank the Tank. He's in that building down the road. Then we'll talk. This might help.
ZH: 我告诉你，你去杀了“坦克弗兰克”。他就在那幢建筑里。然后我们再谈谈。这个可能会有帮助。

EN: Paula Plumbkin escaped from the Feral Ghouls and headed to Vault 333. Hopefully we can catch up with her there.
ZH: 宝拉·普朗布金从狂尸鬼的手里逃了出来，去向了333号避难所。希望我们能在那儿追上她。

EN: Nearby Settlers have become very sick following the annual St. Patrick's Day festivities, with some reported cases of Ghoulification! This might just be, um, “food” poisoning, but we should investigate in case it's an actual epidemic...
ZH: 随着一年一度圣帕特里克节庆祝活动的到来，附近的一些定居者病得很厉害。一些病例报告显示他们正在逐渐变成尸鬼。这可能只是，呃，“食物”中毒，但我们应该调查此事，以防它是一个真正的流行病……

EN: Not a great idea to combine Absinthe and Ultrajet. We had to get rid of him - he was out of control!
ZH: 把苦艾酒和超强捷特混在一起可不是好主意。我们只好把他处理掉——他已经完全失控了！

EN: The Overseer's son got married to a Raider, but she sold him to Slavers! We have to catch them before they disappear west!
ZH: 监督者的儿子和一个掠夺者结婚了，但她把他卖给了奴隶贩子！我们必须赶紧抓住他们！

EN: The Vault received an anonymous message promising to reveal the secret origin of the Horsemen. The location it gives is far into the Wasteland, but it's worth the risk to find out what this person has to say.
ZH: 避难所收到一封匿名信，声称要揭示末日骑士的秘密起源。信中所说位置在废土深处，但为了弄明白这人想说些什么，冒这个险也值得。

EN: Okay, so the Raiders didn't lead us to Coach. It was worth a shot. Maybe he's taking a nap in the old mattress factory!
ZH: 好吧，所以掠夺者没能带我们找到教练。但还是值得一试。也许他会在旧的床垫厂小睡一会儿。

EN: Our boy got traded into marriage against his will, sold into slavery, shipped to a meat factory and now some Raiders have him hostage... What's next?
ZH: 我们的孩子被拐卖给别人，强制结婚，后来又被卖给人贩子，最后送进了肉加工厂。现在一些掠夺者把他作为人质……接下来会发生什么？

EN: Think he said something about the Kendall Hospital. Take this. He left it on accident, but I think you could use it.
ZH: 记得他好像提到了肯德尔医院。拿着这个。他不小心留下的。我觉得你们能用得上。

EN: Some Raiders have kidnapped some settlers and have them held hostage at Vault 778. Maybe they know where Preston Garvey went.
ZH: 某个掠夺者绑架了一些定居者，并将他们作为人质关在了778号避难所，也许他们知道普雷斯顿·加维去了哪里。

EN: War vs. Pestilence vs. Famine. Warshippers vs. Pests vs. Hungry. Everyone's arrived at Vault 226, ready to fight, but we shouldn't leave anything to chance. Let's wade through the carnage and make sure none of the Horsemen survive!
ZH: “战争”，“瘟疫”和“饥荒”的对决。“战争崇拜者”，“害虫”和“饥饿者”的对决。每个人都到达了226号避难所，准备战斗，但我们不能心存侥幸。让我们踏过这片屠杀现场，确保没有活着的末日骑士！

EN: Maybe Rackie Jobinson got his amazing athletic prowess from drinking lots of coffee. It's time to search the Slocum's Joe!
ZH: 也许罗基·杰宾森惊人的运动才能是因为喝了很多咖啡。是时候查看一下斯诺克姆乔伊甜甜圈店了。

EN: A note from someone named Henrietta has led us to Vault 232. Hopefully she can lead us to Rackie Jobinson's Jersey!
ZH: 一位名叫亨丽埃塔的人留下了一些信息，让我们去232号避难所。但愿她能指引我们找到罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫！

EN: Great news! We've been invited to participate in the Miss Wasteland pageant, which - in spite of its name - is open to men and women. Put on your nicest looking swimsuit and knock 'em dead!
ZH: 好消息！我们受邀参加“废土小姐”选美比赛。有别于它的名字，这个比赛共同面向男人和女人。请大家穿上最美的泳装来艳压群芳吧。

EN: We sent one of our Dwellers to bring food to the old Non-Feral Ghoul known as “Grandmamma,” but we haven't heard from her in a while. We need to send a team to investigate!
ZH: 我们派一个居民把食物带给一只温顺的尸鬼名叫“奶奶”。但我们好久没听到她的消息了。赶紧派遣一个小组去调查吧！

EN: We need to send a message to a friend who has infiltrated a gang of Raiders. Your mission is to drop the message at a nearby Super-Duper Mart for him to pick up. Try not to get spotted. Or, you know, killed.
ZH: 我们需要给一个渗透进掠夺者帮派的朋友带个信。你的任务是在附近的大无敌超市里放下消息，然后他会捡起来。尽量不要被发现。或者，你知道，被杀。

EN: You've found the location of a Vault-Tec Lunchbox! Now we just need to send some volunteers to retrieve it.
ZH: 你已经找到了避难所科技午餐盒的地点！现在我们只需派些志愿者居民去把它取回来。

EN: Coach survived the Alpha Deathclaw, but he won't survive me! The Sultan of Slime left another narcissistic note, so we know he's still out there. The search continues!
ZH: 教练在领头死爪爪下活了下来，但他活不过我！“黏液苏丹”又留下一张自恋的纸条，所以我们知道他还在外面。继续搜索！

EN: Somewhere out there in the Wasteland is the Jersey of legendary baseball player Rackie Jobinson. Play ball!
ZH: 废土的某个地方有一件棒球衫，它是棒球界的传奇运动员罗基·杰宾森的。让我们找到它！

EN: Okay, so the first location was a bust. On to the second. The Quest to find Rackie Jobinson's Jersey continues!
ZH: 好吧，第一个地点并没有什么用。现在前往第二个。继续寻找罗基·杰宾森棒球衫！

EN: In order to scare the Raiders away from Vault 31, a helpful traveler suggested getting Ghost Costumes from an old factory nearby.
ZH: 为了把31号避难所的掠夺者吓跑，一位乐于助人的旅行者建议我们去附近的工厂找到鬼服。

EN: Three Dog reports that the Pests and the Hungry are about to face off right where a settlement stands! We need to stop them and save as many Settlers as possible. Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.
ZH: 三狗报告说，“害虫”和“饥饿者”的人即将开战，正落在一个定居点所在之处！我们需要阻止他们，尽可能多的拯救定居者。同时，我们应该留心每周博览会的记者，并在他们谈论核子可乐之后使用代号“鹰”。

EN: A tough Raider boss is holed up in a Red Rocket fuel station, and he's using your Wasteland explorer for target practice. Take him out before someone gets hurt!
ZH: 一个凶悍的掠夺者首领藏匿在红火箭服务站，他正在把你的废土探险者当做练习的靶子。请在有人受伤之前阻止他。

EN: I stumbled across a Ghoul who used to be one of Maxson's Roughnecks. He told me the rest of his team is trapped in Vault 390. It's time for a rescue mission!
ZH: 我遇到了一个尸鬼，曾是“麦克森硬汉小队”的一员。他告诉我小队里其他的成员被困在了390号避难所。是时候开始营救任务了！

EN: A nearby Raider gang is calling you out! Time to show them who's boss...in style! Put on your best threads and start kicking butt!
ZH: 附近的掠夺者团伙正在向你们叫阵！是时候让他们知道谁才是老大了……而且要有型！穿上你最体面的行头，去把他们揍趴下！

EN: One of the Vault youngsters was playing outside when a terrifying monster stole their teddy bear. Now they refuse to sleep, claiming the monster comes back every night to hide under their bed! We've got to track the beast down to end the kid's fears - permanently.
ZH: 一群避难所小朋友在外面玩耍时，一只可怕的怪兽偷走了他们的泰迪熊。现在他们拒绝睡觉，说那只怪兽每晚都会来，躲在他们的床下！我们必须要找到这个怪兽，不再让这些孩子担惊受怕。

EN: Will you use it for spare parts, or riding in your spare time? Up to you, you're the Overseer. Send Dwellers to get one!
ZH: 你想用它来制造零件，还是在闲暇时间骑一骑？你说得算，谁让你是监督者。派你的居民们去弄一匹回来。

EN: What better way to learn about the deadly Glowing Radscorpion than first-hand observation? Send your research team to the monster's lair. Of course, you'll need to kill it first.
ZH: 想要研究发光辐射蝎的致死性，有什么比亲自观察更好呢？派遣你的研究队深入怪兽洞穴吧。当然你得先杀了它。

EN: Some slick raiders breached our vault and made off with critical supplies. We traced them to an abandoned Vault-Tec site near the Strip.
ZH: 一伙狡猾的掠夺者闯进我们的避难所，偷走了关键物资。我们一路追踪，追到新维加斯大道附近一座废弃的避难所科技基地。

EN: When we shut down the Molerat gang, we uncovered a series of failed experiments, each one a threat the security of New Vegas. The next one concerns Ghouls.
ZH: 当我们捣毁鼹鼠帮派时，我们发现了一系列失败实验，每一个都威胁着新维加斯的安全。下一个实验与尸鬼有关。

EN: Did you know: 75% of wastelanders fantasize about Ghouls? Become part of a post-nuclear harem, like us.
ZH: 你知道吗：75%的废土人都幻想过尸鬼？像我们一样，加入一个核后时代的后宫吧。

EN: It reads <Subjects severed from the collective. Silence and despair imminent.> Our job here is done!
ZH: 上面写着<受试者已脱离集体。即将陷入沉默与绝望。>我们的任务完成了！

EN: Next on our list of failed experiments to shut down: Vault Tech has unleashed the subversive power of philosophy. Everyone's sanity is at risk.
ZH: 接下来要关闭的失败实验：避难所科技释放了颠覆性的哲学力量。所有人的理智都危在旦夕。

EN: We are survivors. We are resilient. Isn't there beauty in that? Consider it, as you keep walking, please.
ZH: 我们是幸存者。我们坚韧不拔。难道这不算一种美吗？请边走边想想吧。

EN: But we are many, seeking enlightment, threatened by the selfishness of ones like you. Could a bribe prevail?
ZH: 但我们人数众多，寻求开悟，却受到你们这种自私者的威胁。贿赂能行得通吗？

EN: Ah! An idiot savant! You will need this to survive the wasteland. As for us, we promise to stay in here.
ZH: 啊！白痴学者！在废土上活下去，你会需要这个的。至于我们，我们保证留在这里不出去。

EN: Is that why you humans love your tools so much? Take this and go prove you're alive! We will not leave this vault, promise.
ZH: 这就是你们人类如此热爱工具的原因吗？拿着这个，去证明你还活着吧！我们绝不离开这座避难所，保证。

EN: We located the control site for all the failed experiments. Time to put an end to them once and for all.
ZH: 我们找到了所有失败实验的控制中心。是时候一劳永逸地终结它们了。

EN: Hey! You! Psst! I can help with the Deathclaws. I need a sample of their DNA though. Can you arrange that?
ZH: 嘿！喂！嘘！我能帮忙对付死爪。但我需要它们的DNA样本。你能弄到吗？

EN: Ah, crawled out of your vault? Here to ask for my Securitrons, like the so-called “leaders” of the Strip?
ZH: 啊，从你们的避难所里爬出来了？像新维加斯大道那些所谓的“领袖”一样，来找我要保安机器人？

EN: This weapon might come in handy. You should also seek a Ghoul who calls himself The King. He is useful.
ZH: 这把武器或许派得上用场。你还应该去找一位自称为“猫王”的尸鬼。他很有用。

EN: Another sycophant! Then The King will adore you. You should seek his help too. And take this for your trouble.
ZH: 又是一个阿谀奉承之辈！那“猫王”肯定会很喜欢你的。你也该去向他求援。拿着这个吧，算作你的辛苦费。

EN: Our efforts have paid off. The last remaining Deathclaws and their Alpha have been cornered in a cave.
ZH: 我们的努力有了回报。最后剩下的死爪和它们的首领阿尔法被逼进了一个山洞。

EN: Looks like Rubarb is just getting started. You've received a distress call from Overseer Zilewski's Vault. Better investigate!
ZH: 看起来鲁巴布只是刚刚开始。你收到了监督者扎勒斯基的求救电话。最好去调查一下！

EN: Some of Maxson's Roughnecks were killed at the Wilson Atomatoys Factory, the rest retreated to the Poseidon Energy Offices. That's where I need to go.
ZH: “麦克森硬汉小队”的一些人在威尔逊原子玩具厂被杀害了。其他人撤回到了海神能源办公室。我要去那里。
